text_en: About this time Antiochus made his second invasion of Egypt.
text_cn: 那时，安提约古正准备第二次进攻埃及。

text_en: And it happened that, for almost forty days, there appeared over all the city golden-clad cavalry charging through the air, in companies fully armed with lances and drawn swords—
text_cn: 在全耶路撒冷城，出现了一异像近四十天之久：成队的骑兵，有些身穿金衣，手执干戈，在空中奔驰；

text_en: troops of cavalry drawn up, attacks and counterattacks made on this side and on that, brandishing of shields, massing of spears, hurling of missiles, the flash of golden trappings, and armor of all kinds.
text_cn: 骑阵依次展开，双方反复冲杀，盾牌闪烁，干戈成林，刀剑挥舞，箭矢横飞，金甲银盔，光辉灿烂。

text_en: Therefore everyone prayed that the apparition might prove to have been a good omen.
text_cn: 众人都祝祷这是吉祥之兆。

text_en: When a false rumor arose that Antiochus was dead, Jason took no fewer than a thousand men and suddenly made an assault on the city. When the troops on the wall had been forced back and at last the city was being taken, Menelaus took refuge in the citadel.
text_cn: 正当此时，虚报安提约古驾崩，雅松遂率领千余人，忽然袭击圣城，城墙的守兵败退，城被占领，默乃劳便逃入城堡。

text_en: But Jason kept relentlessly slaughtering his compatriots, not realizing that success at the cost of one’s kindred is the greatest misfortune, but imagining that he was setting up trophies of victory over enemies and not over compatriots.
text_cn: 雅松遂残杀圣城的同胞，毫不顾惜；他没有想到：战胜自己的同胞，正是最大的不幸；自以为是战胜仇敌，而不是战胜亲族。

text_en: He did not, however, gain control of the government; in the end he got only disgrace from his conspiracy, and fled again into the country of the Ammonites.
text_cn: 但他没有得到大权，结果，只得含羞地逃到阿孟地域去。

text_en: Finally he met a miserable end. Accused before Aretas the ruler of the Arabs, fleeing from city to city, pursued by everyone, hated as a rebel against the laws, and abhorred as the executioner of his country and his compatriots, he was cast ashore in Egypt.
text_cn: 他的结局非常凄惨：首先被阿剌伯王阿勒达监禁， 后逃窜各城，为众人所追逐；人憎恨他有如罪犯，厌恶他好像屠杀祖国和同胞的凶手；他只得跑到埃及去。

text_en: There he who had driven many from their own country into exile died in exile, having embarked to go to the Lacedaemonians in hope of finding protection because of their kinship.
text_cn: 那从祖国驱逐无数民众的雅松，如今飘流到拉刻待孟人那里， 希望以同族的关系，可以在那里避难安身；结果，竟客死异乡。

text_en: He who had cast out many to lie unburied had no one to mourn for him; he had no funeral of any sort and no place in the tomb of his ancestors.
text_cn: 从前他曾暴露多人的尸体未得掩埋；如今也没有人哭悼他，也没有人举丧，也没有人将他葬在祖茔（yíng）里。

text_en: When news of what had happened reached the king, he took it to mean that Judea was in revolt. So, raging inwardly, he left Egypt and took the city by storm.
text_cn: 王一听到这些消息，以为是犹太人起来叛乱，一时咆哮如野兽，当下离开埃及，带领大军占领了圣城；

text_en: He commanded his soldiers to cut down relentlessly everyone they met and to kill those who went into their houses.
text_cn: 命军队逢人便杀，毫不留情；凡上到屋顶的，也都要搜杀净尽；

text_en: Then there was massacre of young and old, destruction of boys, women, and children, and slaughter of young girls and infants.
text_cn: 于是残杀老幼，灭绝妇孺，屠杀处女婴儿。

text_en: Within the total of three days eighty thousand were destroyed, forty thousand in hand-to-hand fighting, and as many were sold into slavery as were killed.
text_cn: 三日之内，杀害了八万人，四万丧身刀下，其余的被卖为奴。

text_en: Not content with this, Antiochus dared to enter the most holy temple in all the world, guided by Menelaus, who had become a traitor both to the laws and to his country.
text_cn: 王还以为不足，又以背叛法律出卖祖国的默乃劳为向导，胆敢进入举世至圣的圣殿，

text_en: He took the holy vessels with his polluted hands, and swept away with profane hands the votive offerings that other kings had made to enhance the glory and honor of the place.
text_cn: 伸出他罪污的手攫（jué）取圣器，以他凡俗的手，夺去各国君王，为加增圣殿的光荣与尊严所献的礼品。

text_en: Antiochus was elated in spirit, and did not perceive that the Lord was angered for a little while because of the sins of those who lived in the city, and that this was the reason he was disregarding the holy place.
text_cn: 安提约古一时大为得意，却不想这只是上主，为了城内居民的罪恶，暂时动怒转眼不顾圣所罢了。

text_en: But if it had not happened that they were involved in many sins, this man would have been flogged and turned back from his rash act as soon as he came forward, just as Heliodorus had been, whom King Seleucus sent to inspect the treasury.
text_cn: 若不是因为居民的罪恶满盈，他必定也如色娄苛王打发来视察宝库的赫略多洛一样一来到，就立刻遭受鞭打，不得任意妄为了！

text_en: But the Lord did not choose the nation for the sake of the holy place, but the place for the sake of the nation.
text_cn: 但是，上主并不是为了圣所而选择了国民，而是为了国民而选择了圣所。

text_en: Therefore the place itself shared in the misfortunes that befell the nation and afterward participated in its benefits; and what was forsaken in the wrath of the Almighty was restored again in all its glory when the great Lord became reconciled.
text_cn: 所以那分受民众所遭灾难的圣所，后来也得分享他们的幸福；那在全能者义怒下被遗弃的圣殿，与至上之主和好后，仍然要恢复以前所有的光荣。

text_en: So Antiochus carried off eighteen hundred talents from the temple, and hurried away to Antioch, thinking in his arrogance that he could sail on the land and walk on the sea, because his mind was elated.
text_cn: 安提约古从圣殿里攫（jué）取了一千八百“塔冷通”以后，迅速回到安提约基雅去；他心中自鸣得意，竟然妄想陆地行舟，海上步行。

text_en: He left governors to oppress the people: at Jerusalem, Philip, by birth a Phrygian and in character more barbarous than the man who appointed him;
text_cn: 他留下的官吏，与百姓为难；在耶路撒冷留下夫黎基雅人斐理伯，这人性情残暴，甚于委派他的人；

text_en: and at Gerizim, Andronicus; and besides these Menelaus, who lorded it over his compatriots worse than the others did. In his malice toward the Jewish citizens,
text_cn: 在革黎斤山地留下安多尼苛 此外还有默乃劳，这人虐待本国人比外人更凶残。安提约古王因对犹太人心怀仇恨，

text_en: Antiochus sent Apollonius, the captain of the Mysians, with an army of twenty-two thousand, and commanded him to kill all the grown men and to sell the women and boys as slaves.
text_cn: 就派米息雅的军长阿颇罗尼率领二万二千人，命他杀尽了年富力强的壮丁，把妇女与幼童出卖。

text_en: When this man arrived in Jerusalem, he pretended to be peaceably disposed and waited until the holy sabbath day; then, finding the Jews not at work, he ordered his troops to parade under arms.
text_cn: 阿颇罗尼到了耶路撒冷，假仁假义，等到安息圣日，明知犹太人都停工安息，便命部队武装起来，列队游行。

text_en: He put to the sword all those who came out to see them, then rushed into the city with his armed warriors and killed great numbers of people.
text_cn: 凡出来观望的人，都用刀砍死，然后率领武装部队，走遍全城，杀了无数的居民。

text_en: But Judas Maccabeus, with about nine others, got away to the wilderness, and kept himself and his companions alive in the mountains as wild animals do; they continued to live on what grew wild, so that they might not share in the defilement.
text_cn: 犹大玛加伯同其余九人，逃到旷野，住在山中，形同野兽，饥食野菜，免染不洁。
